target: AArch64 UTM-bundled QEMU with HVF, one vCPU, virtio-ramfb, VirtIO keyboard/tablet, disposable VirtIO disk
command: QEMU=build/utm-qemu-probe/qemu-probe QEMU_VIRT='-L /Applications/UTM.app/Contents/Resources/qemu -machine virt,accel=hvf,gic-version=3 -cpu host -smp 1 -m 1024 -device virtio-ramfb -device virtio-keyboard-device -device virtio-tablet-device' ZEAL_COMPAT_LOG_PATH=build/check-stock-redsea-drive-api-current.log python3 -u scripts/check-compat.py --pci --probe-stock-redsea-file
checks: Mounted the bounded read-only stock RedSea fixture as D:.
Drive('D') selected the mounted drive and set the bridge's virtual-disk cwd to disk:/.
FilesFind located a nested file through D:/ and relative current-drive enumeration; it excluded source-only /System/InFile.ZC from the disk namespace.
Nested and case-insensitive reads, empty-file semantics, directory enumeration, and invalid-path rejection passed.
The source-backed store preserved empty files across a cold disk-only boot; compaction and zstatus failed=0 passed.
scope_note: Automated UTM-bundled QEMU evidence for the exact ISO, not a live UTM UI or physical Pi result. D: is explicitly mounted and read-only. This does not establish writable RedSea, general device discovery/mounting, FAT32, or removable-media behavior.
